name: Archdemons of Capenna
description: Powerful enemies of the angels who allied with them, then betrayed them.

description_citations.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archangels strike a deal with the archdemons, founding New Capenna as a fortress city.
timeline.quote: the archangels turned to an old, familiar enemy: the archdemons

citation.text: "Capenna", section "The creation of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Refugees stream into the city and the last elevator arrives; New Capenna is sealed to all below.
timeline.quote: the last elevator arrived, and New Capenna was sealed to all below

citation.text: "Capenna", section "The creation of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archdemons plot to trap the angels and spread their essence across New Capenna to drive the enemy back.
timeline.quote: trap the angels, and let an age of demons begin

citation.text: "Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archdemons appoint five families, trap the archangels during a victory celebration and convert them into Halo, then vanish.
timeline.quote: The Demon Lords used the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared themselves.

citation.text: "Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Phyrexian attack, archangels and demonlords strike an unlikely deal that creates the metropolis of New Capenna.
timeline.quote: An unlikely deal between arch angels and demonlords created the metropolis of New Capenna.

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archdemons appoint five families to rule the city and confer demon status on each family head.
timeline.quote: the archdemons appointed five families to rule the city in their name

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The last elevator arrives and New Capenna is sealed to all below after the final battle.
timeline.quote: The enemy rebuffed, the last elevator arrived, and New Capenna was sealed to all below.

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archdemons plot to trap the angels and distribute their essence across the city.
timeline.quote: trap the angels, and let an age of demons begin

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taking advantage of a Phyrexian slumber, the archdemons and the five capture the archangels during a victory celebration, converting their bodies into Halo.
timeline.quote: the five captured the archangels and their hosts during a city-wide celebration of victory

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Demon Lords use the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappear.
timeline.quote: The Demon Lords used the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared themselves.

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The angels propose an alliance to the archdemons, who accept, and together turn back the tide of war.
timeline.quote: The demons accepted the alliance and, together with the angels, turned back the tide of war.

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna", section "The angel-demon pact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angels and demons build a fortress on a plateau that becomes New Capenna; the final fight takes place at the base of the elevators and the city is sealed.
timeline.quote: After the final elevator departed towards the city, New Capenna was sealed

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna", section "Creation of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archdemons betray the angels, turning their bodies into Halo, defeat the Phyrexians, and raise five individuals to demonic status over five factions.
timeline.quote: the archdemons proved their nature and captured the angels

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna", section "Betrayal and the creation of Halo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

era.label: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

timeline.summary: The remaining angels turn on their captors and betrayers, the demons.
timeline.quote: turned their focus on their captors and betrayers, the demons

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "Revenge of the angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xander, an ailing artist, accepts the archdemons' gift of eternal life and unwittingly becomes a vampire.
timeline.quote: He was offered the gift of eternal life from the plane's archdemons

citation.text: "Xander", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xander becomes one of the five family heads and signatories of the contract that created New Capenna.
timeline.quote: He was one of the five heads of families that were appointed by the archdemons

citation.text: "Xander", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
